about_me.title: Santanu Bhunia
about_me.content:
I am an **AI/ML engineer and research intern** working across the full speech stack: speech-to-text, large language models and text-to-speech, trained, fine-tuned and wired together into voices that answer in real time.

My days go into shaving latency off every hop between a person speaking and a model replying, and into turning research checkpoints into production services that stay observable and reliable.

### What I care about

- Systems that feel instant and natural to talk to
- Models that are measured, monitored and boring in production
- Learning in public and building things people actually use

### Outside the terminal

Travelling, books, and a quiet corner for devotion. They all live in this house: the globe, the library and the diya on my desk.

### Education

**B.Tech, Computer Science & Engineering** · Swami Vivekananda University · 2023 – 2027 · YGPA 8.86 / 8.76

voice_agent.title: Real-time Voice Agent
voice_agent.content:
An end-to-end **speech-to-speech** pipeline: the agent listens, understands, thinks with an LLM and talks back, fast enough to feel like a conversation.

### The pipeline

- **Transport:** real-time audio over WebRTC with **LiveKit**
- **Orchestration:** **Pipecat** pipelines wiring the stages together
- **Listen:** streaming speech-to-text
- **Think:** an LLM generating the response token by token
- **Speak:** text-to-speech streaming audio back

### What I work on

- Stacking STT, LLM and TTS so each stage starts before the previous one finishes
- Finding and cutting latency at every hop
- Deploying the stack to production and keeping it observable

### Stack

LiveKit · Pipecat · Python · Docker · Redis · Celery · Grafana

speech_models.title: Speech Model Training
speech_models.content:
Training and fine-tuning the models that let machines **hear** and **speak**.

### Speech-to-Text

- Training and fine-tuning ASR models on domain audio
- Preparing and cleaning speech datasets
- Optimising inference for streaming, low-latency transcription

### Text-to-Speech

- Training and fine-tuning TTS voices
- Balancing naturalness against synthesis speed for real-time use

### Why it matters

A voice agent is only as good as its ears and its voice. These models are the first and last mile of every conversation.

llm_training.title: LLM Fine-tuning & Serving
llm_training.content:
Taking language models from a training run to a **production endpoint**.

### Training

- Training and fine-tuning LLMs for specific products and tasks
- Evaluating checkpoints before they reach users

### Serving

- Deploying different LLMs into production-ready environments
- Containerised services with **Docker**, queues and workers with **Redis** and **Celery**
- Dashboards and alerts in **Grafana** so latency and errors are always visible

### Focus

Low time-to-first-token, predictable throughput, and services that stay up.

globe_travel_history.title: The places I carry
globe_travel_history.content:
Travelling is that thread in my life that is directly connected to my soul. It gives me a different kind of happiness. I love to inhale the calmness, the busyness, the people, and their culture. I always wonder what Mother Nature wanted to create there. As I travel, I begin to relate everything with all the knowledge I've gathered throughout my life. I hope one day I'll go far beyond my own imagination.
